scripts.quint:run: npm run quint:run:l1 && npm run quint:run:fees
scripts.quint:fixtures: rm -f models/traces/*.itf.json && mkdir -p models/traces && quint test models/l1.qnt --out-itf 'models/traces/l1_{test}.itf.json' --verbosity=0
scripts.quint:test: npm run quint:test:l1 && npm run quint:test:fees
scripts.quint:test:l1: quint typecheck models/l1.qnt && quint test models/l1.qnt --verbosity=2
scripts.quint:test:fees: quint typecheck models/fees.qnt && quint test models/fees.qnt --verbosity=2
